name: Playhead
notes:
**Smooth playback on Android (TV, Google TV sticks, phones, tablets)**
- New playback engine on Android: ExoPlayer, the player Plex uses. It decodes on the device's video hardware and draws straight to the screen, which keeps CPU use low. If a file isn't supported, Playhead switches to the compatibility player automatically, at the same position.
- Change it in Settings → Playback → Player engine.
- The player's stats overlay shows the active decoder and any dropped frames.
- Auto picks 1080p at most on Fast start and Balanced. Best quality may pick 4K, but only if the device can hardware-decode it.

**Player**
- New Quality picker in the player (the "1080p" button). It lists every available quality with its size and approximate data use per hour, and you can pick any of them.
- TV remote:
  - OK plays or pauses.
  - Left/Right seek 10 s.
  - Up/Down open the controls. They no longer change the volume.
  - The remote's media keys work.

**Android TV navigation**
- Left from the first item of any row goes back to the sidebar.
- Your profile is at the top of the sidebar.
- Opening a page lands on its first item at the top.
- Text fields open the keyboard only when you press OK.
- No more zoom on focus. Focus rings have a small gap from the item and aren't cut off.
- The detail page's info table can be reached with the remote.

**New**
- Kids profiles with a PIN:
  - Each kids profile has an age band (Up to 6, 7–12, 13–15, 16–17), based on TMDB age ratings for your country. Unrated titles are hidden.
  - The PIN guards leaving a kids profile, opening Settings, and blocked titles. You can change it in Settings → Profiles & data.
- Activity shows your watch history: resume, remove one entry, or clear it all.

**Security**
- Playhead only ever downloads and plays the video file. Torrents containing programs, scripts or disguised files are blocked.
- Downloads get the system's "downloaded from the internet" mark.

**Android phones and tablets**
- Real app icon.
- The player goes fullscreen in landscape.
- The keyboard no longer covers fields.
- The back gesture works.
- Touch targets are larger.

**Also**
- Settings → Profiles & data → Reset Playhead deletes everything on this device and starts over from setup. It asks for the PIN if one is set.
- The built-in Internet Archive source finds the Blender open movies again (Sintel, Big Buck Bunny…). It was only searching the feature-films collection, and its search timed out before results came back.
- During onboarding on TV, Next has focus as soon as the catalogue is ready.
- Back from a detail page returns to the poster you opened, not the sidebar.
- Old update files are deleted after updating.
- Appearance settings appear only on devices that support them.

Windows stays on build 6 for this test release.
